# NetSift

> NetSift is a desktop packet analyzer for macOS and Linux: live capture and pcap/pcapng files, live decryption of HTTPS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 from SSLKEYLOGFILE key logs, per-app traffic attribution, an HTTP request waterfall with HAR export, and capture comparison. Part of the Cydra Suite by Cydraintel.

- Platforms: macOS 11 or newer (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux x64 and ARM64 (glibc 2.35+). Windows is planned (needs Npcap).
- Capture: live capture via libpcap with BPF capture filters; opens pcap and pcapng; saves pcap.
- Decryption: TLS 1.2 (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305) and TLS 1.3 including key updates; QUIC v1 and v2 with header protection, coalesced packets and 1-RTT key updates; QUIC Initial packets decrypt without keys; Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) sessions; key log re-read automatically.
- HTTP: HTTP/1.x, HTTP/2 (HPACK) and HTTP/3 (QPACK with dynamic table) decoded and filterable; request waterfall with connection setup, wait and download; HAR 1.2 export.
- Per-app traffic: each connection attributed to its local process during live capture (macOS PKTAP metadata plus socket table, Linux /proc); no root needed for the user's own processes; filters process, app, pid.
- Compare: matches packets between two captures on ports, TCP sequence numbers, flags and payload; reports missing and new packets and the delay between capture points; filter compare.missing.
- Search: Wireshark-style display filters evaluated in parallel; 8-73 ms per search over 1.03 million packets once loaded (Apple M4 Pro).
- Insights: retransmissions, resets, zero windows, DNS and HTTP errors, TLS alerts.
- CLI: netsift query, sessions, http, har, diff; -w writes matching packets to pcap.
- Runs locally: no telemetry, no account, no update check.
- License: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 (free for organizations under 100 people and US$1M revenue).
- Install on macOS or Linux: `curl -fsSL https://nyanites.github.io/netsift/install.sh | sh`
